newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Managers appointed for Metway merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Managers appointed for Metway merger.

text.p: The Queensland state government said it appointed three stockbroking firms as joint lead managers for transactions involving the merger of Metway Bank Ltd with state-owned Suncorp and Queensland Industry Development Corp Ltd (QIDC).
They were Morgan Stockbroking, Wilson HTM Ltd and J.B.Were & Son, Treasurer Joan Sheldon said in a statement.

The lead managers would be responsible for the marketing of the merger to Metway shareholders as well as the planned issue of Exchanging Preferred Units (EPU) and the state government's planned sell-down to 15 percent of the merged group from an initial 70 percent, Sheldon said.
The EPU issue will fund the cash component of the merger between Suncorp, Metway and QIDC.
Sheldon said the merged entity would operate on a totally commercial footing with the government planning to sell down its holding over five years.

Under arrangements with the joint lead managers, all brokers with Brisbane headquarters and other Brisbane-based brokers would be offered participation at various stages of the merger process, Sheldon said.

Chairman-elect of the merged group, John Lamble, said the new entity would offer opportunities for growth and a stronger business base with assets of A$19 billion and expected profits of more than $200 million.
